memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron: "Take a census of the Kohathite branch of the Levites by their clans and families. Count all the men from thirty to fifty years of age who come to serve in the work at the tent of meeting." - Num 4:1-3 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God asks for a special count of the Kohathites — but only the men between thirty and fifty years of age. These were the ones in their season of full strength, ready for the demanding physical work of carrying the tabernacle.

There is wisdom in this. God matched the work to the season of life. The very young and the very old were not called to this heavy carrying; that task belonged to those with the strength for it. God does not ask from us what we cannot give, and He fits His callings to the season we are in.

This is a quiet encouragement. You may be in a season of great energy and capacity — then use that strength for God while you have it. Or you may be in a season of limitation, whether through age, health, or circumstance — and God is not asking you to carry what belongs to another season. There is a time for every kind of service.

The point is not that only the strong matter to God. The point is that God knows exactly what season you are in and calls you accordingly. Whatever your stage of life, God has meaningful work suited to you.

Serve God faithfully in the season you are in today — not the one behind you or the one ahead, but the one you are living right now.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- What season of life are you in right now?
- How can you serve God with the strength He has given you today?
- Are you frustrated by limits that belong to your current season?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You call me to serve in the season I am in. Help me to use what You have given me faithfully, today. Amen.
